scientific_goal: Fit and evaluate hybrid frequency models for 0p08 using the 11-band local-excess oscillator bank and test TCN63, TCN15, MLP, and multi-step Energy Score calibrated neural SDE remainder models.
constraints: Identify the eleven complex spatial directions and oscillator parameters from training repetitions 1-12 only; validation repetitions 13-14 are evaluation only and test repetitions 15-16 remain locked.
Preserve the spatial mean plus ten POD coordinates, native sampling, HP50 spatial-mean preprocessing.
Define every target exactly as full minus the filtered eleven rank-one complex projections and verify reconstruction before training.
Keep the complex oscillator bank frozen. Evaluate both raw neural output and output projected through the fixed local-excess complement.
Judge learnability from long-rollout survival, remainder PSD shape and power, energy, increments and ACF.

arms.description: Standard five-epoch TCN-63 one-step NLL baseline on 0p08 remainder.
Compact five-epoch TCN-15 short-memory control on 0p08 remainder.
Memory-light MLP baseline to test memoryless non-local coupling on remainder.
Three-epoch multi-step joint Energy Score calibration fine-tuned from TCN-15.
